chunks: And from his sermon (peace be upon him) concerning the exhortation regarding various matters.
On the excellence of the favors of Allah.
ai.seo_question: What is the main theme of Imam Ali's sermon regarding the favors of Allah in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: In this sermon from *Nahj al-Balagha*, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) establishes the theological foundation of *shukr* (gratitude) by linking the recognition of divine favors (*ni'am*) to the transient nature of worldly life. This discourse, compiled by Sharif al-Radi, serves as a pivotal introduction to understanding how spiritual awareness of God's blessings fosters resilience against the ephemeral distractions of the material world.
